reviews.review:
Elden Ring is one of the most amazing games I've ever played. I have a lot of time in it, and in the entirety of me playing that game, I never once thought, "Hey I wish my friend was right here too". Not because the game wouldn't be good with it, but because it would have to be done is a hyper specific way for it to fit the game and actually be good.

I'm going to be honest. While really excited to try out the game, I was quite worried I would dislike the way they optimized the game for multiplayer. I'm the kind of person who thinks that multiplayer is good with MOST games, but Elden Ring isn't "most games". It cultivates such a perfect atmosphere, combat balance, loot progression system, exploration system, and so much more, but it's all being fitted to a single player. So when you introduce multiplayer, you need to rebalance everything, add new features/lessen or remove features, and completely change the game technically. And since Elden Ring is Elden Ring this is a difficult task.


This game did it perfectly. 
It felt so fluid fighting alongside my friends. I wasn't confined to the enemy I was taking on, but everyone was clashing together to create a epic battle. 
The boss fights felt suspenseful. Friends making insane dodges, impossible wins, clutches when the last person alive had 2HP. It's just perfect. 
The progression system of getting runes and getting to a good level to fight the boss of the day is genius. And all of the things you can do to speed this up are also well made.

Another thing is that the world design is also really cool. 
(Spoilers Ahead)




Like when you fight the first MAJOR boss (the three headed wolf guy), the entrance room is breathtaking. Or sometimes even the bosses before that can look really cool (under the tree thingy)




Ok no more spoilers.

If you love Elden Ring, or any of the souls games, you will love this. And if your not like me and have really wanted a multiplayer elden ring adaption and would prob settle with a good mod then ofc you will love this.
Spam Ashes of War just like normal Elden Ring
